name: Apart Simon Seefeld
beschreibung: The Apart Simon Seefeld is situated in a quiet location, with the center of Seefeld in Tirol within comfortable walking distance. The holiday apartments feature a kitchenette, a separate bedroom, and a bathroom. In-room amenities include satellite TV and Wi-Fi. Most apartment units provide a balcony or terrace. Parking facilities and a ski storage room are readily available. Cross-country skiing trails and the ski bus stop are located nearby. In summer, the accommodation serves as an excellent starting point for scenic hikes across the Seefeld Plateau.
